name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Switches between panels of one object; one indicator slides to the active tab, counts sit beside labels, and a long row scrolls instead of wrapping.
whenToUse: Switching between panels of the same object: Overview, Activity, Settings; Positions and Orders.
notFor: Moving between sections of an app (sidebar).

anatomy: TabsNav (the same row as navigation: nav, indicator)
keyboard: Direction follows explicit props or the managed scope and resolves the surrounding static direction; forwarded refs keep internal direction measurement attached. refreshAppearance updates static scope changes without remounting controls.
TabsNav: Tab moves between items; Enter (links) or Enter and Space (buttons) follow one
spec.motion: The indicator (line or pill) travels as matter (ui/lib/contour.ts), shaped by the look's mechanics (--m-morph-*): in soft its corner facing the new tab answers first, its leading edge rounds out a few pixels, the middle draws a slight neck and the corners round toward a capsule while it is stretched, then it gathers into its plain box. Nothing overshoots (critically damped, ~0.26 s, the far corner a little later). Metal, blueprint and mono stay rigid (it slides and stretches with straight edges); pop stretches most; glass is a little heavier; ink thins like a brush. The choice itself is made at once (state, colour, focus); only the decorative indicator (line or pill) settles. At rest: no clip and no frames. Reduced motion: it jumps. The new panel fades in.

props.name: TabsList.classNames / TabsTrigger.classNames
props.description: See visualContract.slots; existing handlers, accessibility and internal measurement refs are preserved.

props.name: TabsNav / TabsNavItem
props.type: value, defaultValue, onValueChange, variant / value, href?, icon?, count?
props.description: Tabs that switch pages or routes rather than panels: a nav with the same look and travelling indicator, the current item aria-current=page. Tab moves between items, Enter follows one.

props.name: style
props.description: Visual root inline styles; Tabs exported parts each retain their native style attribute.

props.name: ref
props.description: Native visual root/control reference, composed with internal refs when present.

scopeDefaults.precedence: Instance prop, then nearest UIRoot.defaults entry, then existing component fallback. Only presentation keys are accepted; values, callbacks and operational state remain caller-owned.

spec.appearance: className/style address the visual root. Typed classNames customize documented internal parts; composed exported parts retain native attributes. Styling and forwarded refs preserve internal measurement/focus, handlers and accessibility. Appearance changes retain operational state. Indicator geometry follows item resizing, published appearance changes and font completion.

visualContract.root: Tabs div; composed parts each own their native root
visualContract.refTarget: Tabs div; TabsList ref composes with the indicator measurement ref; triggers are buttons and content is div
